title: Final Outcome: Stretch
welcome_lead: Present, photograph and evaluate your outcome to the highest standard.
meta_desc: Stretch GCSE final outcome: presentation, documentation, reflective evaluation.
final_note: Examiners mark what they can see — present so they can see it.

concepts.def: How work is displayed for marking.
Photos or scans recording the final work.
Honest review of the journey of the project.
Judging outcome against the original brief.
How clearly the project tells one story.
How polished and finished the work feels.

walkthroughs.body_html: Mount work cleanly, leave breathing room around each piece and group studies by theme. Even a sketchbook benefits from a tidy contents page. Presentation is not decoration — it is part of communicating your idea.

Photograph the outcome under even light, with no distracting background. Include scale shots if size matters. For 3D work, take multiple angles. Good documentation means the work travels — examiners, portfolios, applications.

Return to the original brief and judge the outcome against it. What did you intend? What did you achieve? Where did intention and result diverge — and was that change deliberate? Strong evaluation is honest, specific and forward-looking.
